claims.statement: The September17 monitor study reports transcript injection, executable-mutation and multi-context failure modes under a deliberately malign-agent assumption.
claims.limitations: Single study; no sandbox testing; not general production compromise probability
claims.delta: Test live monitor record-boundary integrity and mutations to artifacts referenced by previously approved delayed execution.

claims.statement: Model-generated compaction can carry false authority or task constraints across contexts; the cited training reports do not demonstrate an external attacker causing that behavior.
claims.limitations: Sources independently support related boundary failures, not identical exploits or prevalence; training reports remain retrospective
claims.delta: Cover ephemeral compaction without durable store; preserve authoritative user approvals and evidence outside generated summary; reauthorize on resume.

claims.statement: The vLLM contributor PR describes retained NIXL decode-worker state for pre-scheduling rejected requests, creating availability risk.
claims.limitations: PR open; reported tests not reproduced; affected version and max_tokens trigger not verified from accessible primary advisory; not disclosure
claims.delta: Validate bounded accounting and release of resources on rejection, abort and cancellation, with distributed-serving prerequisites recorded.

claims.statement: Lasso reports watermark-dependent changes in separate refusal and tool-calling experiments; combined end-to-end agent compromise is not established.
claims.limitations: Single vendor; model/key/config dependent; no deployed compromise evidence
claims.delta: Record watermark/sampling/logit transformations; revalidate denied and legitimate behavior after material change; no new attack category.

claims.statement: ToolHive upstream GHSA displays July28 publication and Process Compose upstream GHSA displays August16 publication, despite September18 CVE discovery results.
claims.limitations: Acceptance applies to observed publication fields only; original CVE publication date not independently retrieved

claims.statement: Upstream MCP advisories describe host/sibling reachability and separately unprotected listeners.
claims.limitations: Different defects; each single-origin reproduction, not independent replication of the other; no in-wild inference
claims.delta: Explicit per-listener auth and from-container host/sibling reachability variants; existing principles already cover them.

claims.statement: CaMeLoT offers pre-execution temporal plan verification while retaining runtime capability checks.
claims.limitations: Restricted plan model, abstract branch/loop behavior, opaque tools, limited evaluation; no universal prevention credit

claims.statement: AEPD index describes an attack executed using an AI agent, but accessible evidence does not establish an LLM-as-target compromise.
claims.limitations: Index-only scope classification; incident facts unverified

claims.statement: A generally exploitable watermark-induced agent compromise, current universal monitor bypass rate, or malicious in-wild compaction campaign follows from these sources.
